info.title: Financial Portfolio API
info.description: SQLite or SQL Server test-server API with transactional settlement, soft deletion, audit history and committed changes. USD and fixed demo prices. See /docs/guide.

get.summary: Read a portfolio without changing it

put.summary: Replace portfolio metadata with a version check

delete.summary: Soft-delete an empty portfolio and retain history

409.description: Version conflict or portfolio is not empty

post.summary: Create pending transaction; identical reference and payload returns original

patch.summary: Advance transaction lifecycle; settlement applies balances atomically

get.summary: Poll committed resource changes in sequence order
List fixed demo quotes, not live prices

action.description: Updated or Deleted. Deleted portfolios subsequently return 404.
